transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Ever since that car drove into the crowd, even little sounds make me feel like I’m back there and I jump out of my chair or drop things. It has gotten to the point where I feel completely on edge in my own home, and I just didn't know what else to do.
How long has it been since the car accident occurred, and have you been experiencing these symptoms for more than one month?
The accident happened just last week at the downtown street fair. I've been feeling this way for about a week now, so it definitely hasn't been a month yet.
Since the accident, have you felt like you are in a daze, or do you sometimes feel detached from your surroundings or yourself, as if you are watching things from outside your body?

No, I haven't really felt detached or like I'm watching myself from the outside. But I do have some big blank spots in my memory from the day of the accident, where I just can't piece together what happened from one moment to the next.
